messages:
Priya: Heads-up — found a broken inline link on the knowledge handbook page /internal/knowledge-handbook (deploy checklist link returns 404). Can someone claim a tiny fix? :eyes:
Jordan: I can take a look in a bit. Do we know if it's a shortlink or full URL?
Priya: looks like a shortlink that was migrated. path: `/kb/handbook/deploy-checklist` -> 404. Repro: open Handbook > Runtime > Deploy checklist.
Ava (Docs): thanks for the report — pinging owners. If it's a shortlink we should swap to canonical path or add a redirect. Small PR is fine.
Samir: quick suggestion: run `rg "deploy-checklist" -n content/ | sed -n '1,20p'` to find usages, then sed replace. I can open a draft PR after I find all refs.
link-scan-bot: automated scan detected 1 broken link on /internal/knowledge-handbook (severity: low). Created issue #KB-2042.
Jordan: leaving a note — if Samir is on PR, can we do a canary deploy to staging before prod? small rollout makes sense.
Priya: yup canary sounds good. @Samir whenever you have the PR post the link here and I'll add the codeowner and merge after quick review.
Ava (Docs): also, can we add a 1‑line annotation in the handbook about the shortlink migration to prevent future rot? I'll toss a tiny follow-up commit after this.
Samir: will do. ETA ~1.5h to find refs + open PR. Thanks all :party:
